estimates: The model preserves the mapped curved outline and landward rectangle. House dimensions, house position within that envelope, fittings and limestone/granite tones are estimates from the site description.
The visible intake portal and grate are represented at the edge of the platform. The underground tunnel and historical hydraulic operating height are outside the scope of the exterior model.
The 5 m government terrain field was preserved. The height transition to the original ground, footings, catwalk spans and local platform levels are approximate.

review.notes: Checked the published Qualla galleries first. The photographs in the gallery do not provide a cleared view of the exact recorder house and tunnel inlet. The model follows the named native shape and written heritage facts without adopting imagery.
